result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers turn the switch into a button with role="switch" and aria-checked, add focus-visible rings, disable Save while it runs, show saved and error messages, and keep the /api/prefs payload but add a Content-Type header. B fixes the faint off-state track contrast and gives a clearer error message that tells the person to retry. A styles the Save button, which B leaves as the browser default, but keeps a low-contrast off track. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers turn the switch into a keyboard-operable `button role="switch"` with `aria-checked`, give it a proper accessible name, add busy, success and error feedback to Save, and keep the `/api/prefs` payload unchanged. A darkens the off track and focus ring so the two states and the focus indication are easier to see, but leaves the Save button with its default look. B does more visual polish, but keeps a faint off track, uses a lighter focus ring and puts white text on #2a7, which has weak contrast.
